app.name: PrepProfit
app.tagline: Financial management for chefs and food businesses

welcome.subject: Welcome to PrepProfit, {org}
welcome.body: Your organization {org} is ready. Add your ingredients and recipes to start costing, then explore financials, invoices and inventory. Reply to this email if you need a hand.

lowStock.subject: {count, plural, one {# ingredient is running low} other {# ingredients are running low}}
lowStock.body: These ingredients in {org} are at or below their low-stock threshold and may need reordering:

subscribed.subject: You're on PrepProfit {plan} 🎉
subscribed.body: Thanks for subscribing — {org} is now on the {plan} plan and every feature it unlocks is ready to use. You can review or change your plan any time on the billing page. Reply to this email if you need a hand.

upgraded.subject: Your plan is now PrepProfit {plan}
upgraded.body: {org} has been upgraded to the {plan} plan. The extra limits and modules it includes are available immediately. You can review your plan any time on the billing page.

downgraded.subject: Your PrepProfit plan changed to {plan}
downgraded.body: {org} is now on the {plan} plan. Your data is safe and stays exactly as it is; only the plan's limits and modules change. You can move back up any time on the billing page.

pastDue.subject: Action needed: update your payment method
pastDue.body: We couldn't process the latest payment for {org} on the {plan} plan, so the subscription is now past due. Please update your payment method on the billing page to keep your plan active. If you've already updated it, you can ignore this message.

trialEnding.subject: {days, plural, one {Your PrepProfit trial ends tomorrow} other {Your PrepProfit trial ends in # days}}
trialEnding.deadline: {days, plural, one {# day of full access left} other {# days of full access left}}
trialEnding.body: Heads up — {org}'s 14-day full-access trial is ending soon. Pick a plan to keep the paid features you've been using.
trialEnding.fallback: No action needed to stay safe — if you do nothing, {org} simply moves to the Free plan and all your data stays exactly as it is.

footer.tagline: PrepProfit — financial clarity for food businesses.
footer.auto: This is an automated message from your PrepProfit workspace.

actionErrors.PO_LINE_INGREDIENT_MISSING: One of the lines points at an ingredient that no longer exists. Fix the lines before sending.

actionErrors.PO_NOT_CLOSABLE: Only a partially received purchase order can be closed short.

actionErrors.TASK_ASSIGNEE_INVALID: That person isn't a member of this organization. Pick a current team member.

actionErrors.SALES_TAX_RATE_REQUIRED: Set your VAT rate in Settings before posting a sale.
actionErrors.RECIPE_IN_SALE: This recipe is used on a sale, so it can't be deleted forever. The sale keeps it as history.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start.

q1.q: Why not just keep using my spreadsheet?
q1.a: A spreadsheet can work when you have a few products. It starts failing when ingredient prices change, formulas break, recipes multiply and costs like yield, waste, packaging and labor are easy to miss. PrepProfit keeps the costing logic in the product so you are not rebuilding formulas every time something changes.

q2.q: How is this different from a free recipe cost calculator?
q2.a: A calculator gives you one answer once. PrepProfit gives you an organized system for recipes, ingredients, margins, invoices, inventory, exports and pricing decisions over time.

q3.q: Do I have to rebuild everything from scratch?
q3.a: No. You can import data from CSV or Excel, photograph a recipe for a reviewed AI draft, or upload supplier invoice data and review the changes before they affect your numbers.

q4.a: Every new workspace starts with 14 days of Business-level access — no card required. If you do not choose a paid plan, your workspace moves to Free automatically. Your data is not deleted.

q5.q: Does AI change my recipes automatically?
q5.a: No. AI creates a draft for you to review. Nothing becomes final until you confirm it.

q6.a: Yes. PrepProfit is designed so you can bring data in and export clean files when you need them.

q7.a: Yes. Paid plans support team workflows and role-based access, so managers can keep financial data protected while kitchen staff use the operational tools they need.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are

sections.heading: 2. The Service
body: PrepProfit is a business tool for restaurants, bakeries, patisseries and other food businesses: recipe costing, inventory, financial records, break-even analysis, invoicing, payroll summaries, document generation, data imports and AI-assisted recipe extraction.
The Service is offered to businesses and professionals (B2B). By creating an account you confirm that you are acting in the course of a trade, business or profession, not as a consumer.

sections.heading: 3. Accounts and workspaces
body: You need an account to use the Service. You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for all activity under your account.
Data in the Service is organized in workspaces (organizations). Access within a workspace is controlled by roles that the workspace administrator assigns.
You must provide accurate information when signing up and keep it up to date.

sections.heading: 4. Plans, trial and payment
body: Current plans, prices and plan limits are shown on our pricing page and at checkout. Prices may change; changes apply from your next billing period after reasonable notice.

Every new workspace starts with a 14-day trial with access to Business-level features, no payment card required. If you do not choose a paid plan by the end of the trial, the workspace moves to the Free plan automatically and your data is retained.
Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis and renew automatically until cancelled. Payments are processed by our payment provider (Stripe); we do not store card numbers.
You can cancel at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period already invoiced. Except where required by law, fees are non-refundable.

sections.heading: 5. Your data

You can export your data from the Service at any time, and you are responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of the data you enter — including having a legal basis for any personal data (for example employee names) you store in the Service.

sections.heading: 6. AI features

sections.heading: 1. Controller
body: The controller of personal data processed through PrepProfit is a private trader registered in Finland (Business ID 3399953-5, VAT FI33999535), operating under the name "PrepProfit". Contact: info@prepprofit.com.

This policy explains what personal data we process when you visit prepprofit.com or use the PrepProfit application, why, and what rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: 2. Data we process
body: Account data: name, email address and authentication identifiers, managed through our authentication provider (Clerk).

Workspace data: the business data you and your team enter — recipes, ingredients, prices, financial transactions, invoices (which may contain your customers' names and contact details), employee records for payroll summaries, suppliers and similar.

Photos you upload for AI extraction: images of recipes or supplier invoices you choose to submit. They are processed to produce a draft for your review; we store extraction metadata (provider, cost, status), not the image as a permanent record.
Billing data: subscription plan, invoices and payment status. Card details are processed by Stripe and never touch our servers.
Usage data (only with your consent): pageviews, product interactions and session replays via PostHog, hosted in the EU.
Support data: messages you send us by email or through the support chat (Crisp).
Technical logs: IP addresses and request logs kept short-term for security and error diagnosis (Vercel, Sentry).

sections.heading: 3. Why and on what legal basis
body: - Providing the Service, including hosting your workspace data and processing payments — performance of a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
- Security, abuse prevention, audit logging and error monitoring — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).
- Product analytics and session replay — your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), given through the cookie banner and withdrawable at any time.
- Transactional email (receipts, trial reminders, reports you opt into) — performance of a contract; optional report emails are opt-in.
- Legal obligations such as bookkeeping — compliance with law (Art. 6(1)(c)).

sections.heading: 4. Your customers' and employees' data
body: When you store personal data about your own customers or employees in your workspace (for example on invoices or payroll records), you are the controller of that data and PrepProfit processes it on your behalf as a processor, only to provide the Service. Contact us at info@prepprofit.com if you need a data processing agreement.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
body: Strictly necessary (always on): authentication and security cookies (Clerk), your cookie-consent choice, theme preference, and the support chat session (Crisp).

Analytics (opt-in only): PostHog cookies for pageviews, product analytics and session replay. These are set only after you click Accept in the cookie banner, and you can withdraw consent at any time via "Cookie settings" in the footer.
Session replays are used to diagnose usability problems. PostHog is configured on EU servers, and keystrokes in sensitive fields are masked by default.

sections.heading: 6. Processors and recipients
body: We use the following service providers as processors:
- Vercel (USA/EU) — application hosting and logs.
- Neon (EU region) — PostgreSQL database hosting.
- Clerk (USA) — authentication and organization management.
- Stripe — payment processing.
- Resend — transactional email delivery.
- Google (Gemini API) — AI extraction of the photos you submit for that purpose.
- PostHog (EU) — product analytics and session replay, only with your consent.
- Crisp (EU) — support chat.
- Sentry — error monitoring.

Where a provider processes data outside the EU/EEA, transfers rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses and, for US providers, the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where certified. We do not sell personal data.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
body: Account and workspace data is kept while your account is active. Items you delete in the app go to a trash area and are purged on a schedule or when you purge them manually.
If you delete your account, we delete or anonymize your personal data within a reasonable wind-down period, except where law (for example bookkeeping rules) requires longer retention.
Technical logs and analytics data are kept for shorter, provider-standard periods.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, restrict or object to processing, data portability, and to withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing.
You can export your workspace data and request account deletion directly in Settings, or contact us at info@prepprofit.com.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — in Finland, the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto, tietosuoja.fi).

sections.heading: 9. Security
body: Workspace data is isolated per organization with database-level row security, access is role-based, connections are encrypted in transit, and sensitive operations are audit-logged. No system is perfectly secure, but we design for tenant isolation first.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy as the Service evolves. Material changes will be announced by email or in-app notice. The date at the top shows the latest revision.

selectOrg.title: Choose or create an organization
selectOrg.description: Your data is isolated per organization.

purchaseOrders.subtitle: Draft orders to your suppliers, then send them a PDF.
purchaseOrders.empty: No purchase orders yet. Create your first draft to order from a supplier.
purchaseOrders.noSuppliers: Add a supplier first, then you can create purchase orders.
purchaseOrders.noIngredients: Add some ingredients first, then you can add order lines.

builder.title: New purchase order
builder.lineIncomplete: Add at least one line with an ingredient and a quantity.

actions.sendBody: This freezes the supplier and line details and queues a PDF email to the supplier (if they have an email address). A sent order can no longer be edited.
actions.cancelBody: The order is marked cancelled. If a send email has not gone out yet it is stopped; if it already left, the supplier is sent a cancellation notice.
actions.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the draft purchase order. This cannot be undone.

receive.title: Receive delivery
receive.noLines: Enter a received quantity on at least one line.
receive.overBody: One or more lines receive more than was ordered. This is allowed, but please confirm.
receive.shortCloseBody: Mark the order received with the quantities delivered so far. No more deliveries can be booked unless a receipt is voided.

purchaseOrderEmail.subject: Purchase order {number}
purchaseOrderEmail.body: Please find attached purchase order {number} from {seller}. The order details are in the attached PDF.
purchaseOrderEmail.cancelBody: Purchase order {number} has been cancelled. Please disregard the earlier order.
